target_claim.statement: Basal single-cell expression features, especially Nfkbia, are exploratorily associated with the subsequent rate of LPS-induced Tnf-mCherry increase in the observed Live-seq RAW cells.

search_fingerprint.biological_system: RAW264.7-like macrophages exposed to LPS, with single-cell transcriptomic and dynamic inflammatory-response measurements
search_fingerprint.cell_state: unstimulated or pre-response macrophage state linked to a subsequent inflammatory phenotype
search_fingerprint.phenotype_outcome: Tnf-promoter activity, NF-kB signaling dynamics, or a documented biologically comparable single-cell inflammatory-response phenotype
search_fingerprint.assay: single-cell transcriptomics paired at cell level, or in a defensibly matched design, with live-cell or fluorescent dynamic phenotyping
search_fingerprint.time_structure: pre-response molecular state linked to a later response is preferred; post-stimulation matched-cell studies are conceptual rather than direct replication
search_fingerprint.required_biological_unit: independently generated cells or primary macrophages from an experiment unrelated to GSE141064, with a defensible grouping key above technical containers
acceptable_substitutions: same-cell NF-kB dynamics paired with scRNA-seq in an independent RAW264.7 experiment
primary mouse macrophage NF-kB dynamics plus scRNA-seq with documented biological replication
single-cell transcriptomics paired with a fluorescently resolved inflammatory phenotype
unacceptable_substitutions: alternate sequencing runs or flow cells from exp8
the same donor, clone preparation, culture, extraction event, or pooled library material
a new accession that only republishes or repartitions the target samples

sources_searched.query_or_scope: GSE141064-related records; RAW264.7 LPS single-cell RNA-seq with live-cell NF-kB or fluorescent phenotype; macrophage single-cell response datasets
Target PRJNA591913 and candidate accession relationships, sample-level records, raw-data availability, and shared accession leakage
Mouse macrophage, NF-kB, LPS, live-cell imaging, and paired single-cell transcriptome studies

sources_searched.source: article citations, supplements, and related-record links
sources_searched.query_or_scope: Live-seq references, same-cell NF-kB imaging plus scRNA-seq studies, RAW G9 reporter studies, and public accession discovery

candidates.title: Measuring signaling and RNA-Seq in the same cell links gene expression to dynamic patterns of NF-kB activation
candidates.rationale: Independent Stanford/Covert laboratory experiment on Mus musculus RAW264.7 cells. It links live single-cell LPS-induced NF-kB trajectories to scRNA-seq in the same cells and provides public dynamics and expression files. It is the strongest public conceptual candidate, but it measures transcriptomes after stimulation and uses NF-kB dynamics rather than future Tnf-mCherry slope, so it cannot directly replicate the temporal Nfkbia predictor claim without a narrowed secondary endpoint.

candidates.title: Six distinct NF-kB signaling codons convey discrete information to distinguish stimuli and enable appropriate macrophage responses
candidates.rationale: Independent primary mouse bone-marrow-derived macrophage study with LPS, live-cell NF-kB dynamics, and single-cell RNA-seq. It supports the broader relationship between macrophage state, NF-kB dynamics, and transcription, but the public record does not establish a same-cell pre-response transcriptome to later Tnf-promoter phenotype mapping or a compatible grouping structure for the target endpoint.

candidates.title: Single cell time course of macrophages exposed to Salmonella enterica subsp. typhimurium
candidates.rationale: Independent mouse macrophage single-cell time course combining fluorescent infection-state labels with gene expression. It demonstrates phenotype-linked single-cell transcriptomics in an inflammatory macrophage system, but the stimulus, phenotype, and temporal question differ materially from basal Nfkbia predicting later LPS-induced Tnf-mCherry slope.

candidates.title: Single cell analysis of macrophages exposed to beads coated with LPS from Salmonella enterica subsp. typhimurium
candidates.rationale: Independent mouse macrophage dataset combining single-cell transcriptional analysis with fluorescently resolved LPS-bead internalization. It is useful for method and inflammatory-heterogeneity triangulation but does not measure TNF-promoter dynamics or a pre-response molecular predictor.

candidates.title: NF-kB dynamics determine the stimulus-specificity of epigenomic reprogramming in macrophages
candidates.rationale: Independent mouse macrophage LPS/NF-kB study relevant to mechanism, but its bulk transcriptomic and epigenomic design cannot reproduce a single-cell paired predictor-to-future-phenotype association.

candidates.title: Within-study Nfkbia-BFP to Tnf-mCherry validation
candidates.rationale: The Live-seq paper reports a separate Nfkbia-BFP reporter validation and another biological replicate, which strengthens within-study construct validity. It is not an external public dataset and must not be counted as independent repository replication.

independence_leakage_findings.finding: A separate biological replicate inside the same publication is valuable internal validation but cannot be promoted to external independent replication.
Alternate GSM, SRA, plate, lane, library, flow-cell, or reprocessed records attached to PRJNA591913 remain the target study and are not independent candidates.

The temporal direction differs from the target: NF-kB dynamics precede or accompany post-LPS transcriptome collection, whereas the target asks whether a basal transcript predicts a later Tnf-promoter response.

prespecified_test.primary_endpoint: In GSE94383, test whether Nfkbia expression is associated with prespecified single-cell NF-kB trajectory features and inflammatory cytokine-expression output, while explicitly treating this as conceptual replication rather than a direct test of future Tnf-mCherry slope.
prespecified_test.expected_direction: Higher Nfkbia expression is prespecified to associate with a weaker or more rapidly attenuated inflammatory NF-kB/TNF-related response, consistent with negative-feedback biology and the target direction.
prespecified_test.biological_grouping_key: independent experimental run or documented collection batch in GSE94383; individual cells remain nested observations and are not automatically biological replicates
exclusion_criteria: unresolved identity linkage between expression rows and trajectory rows
plate, library, lane, sequencing run, or cell count used as a substitute for biological replication
post hoc trajectory feature selection based on the most favorable Nfkbia result
condition inseparable from an undocumented technical batch
prespecified_test.success_criteria: The identity-linked GSE94383 data reproduce the prespecified direction across at least one biologically relevant NF-kB trajectory or cytokine-output endpoint, remain stable to documented grouping or batch sensitivity checks, and are reported only as conceptual replication because the temporal phenotype differs from GSE141064.

next_valid_action: Download the GSE94383 cell_ids.csv, single_cell_dynamics.csv, and expression matrix; verify one-to-one cell identity and batch structure; then run the frozen Nfkbia conceptual-replication test without changing endpoints after outcome inspection.

safety_status.notes: Live repository search found one accepted conceptual candidate, not direct replication. No physical experiment is authorized.
